# Psalm 122 — Disagreement Log

## 122:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-song of-the-ascents. Of-David. I-was-glad when-they-said to-me, 'To-house-of YHWH let-us-go.'
- **LOGOS:** A Song of Ascents. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, "Let us go to the house of the LORD!"
- **PNEUMA:** A song for the journey to Jerusalem. By David. I was so happy when they said to me, 'Let's go to the LORD's house!'

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
